09.03.02

Crashed my BE again....

I just crashed my BE once again with one of my modified Linux boot loaders, and now it does no longer boot into a CE shell....
I tried normal reset, reset with power button pressed (the initializing progress stuff), reset with OK button to restore from flash and reset with OK button to restore from Pc, and finally a factory restore. None worked. I even left out the battery (disconnected) for 8 hours, reconnected: no-go.
All the same result: my BE boots, does the screen alginment thing, requests my home city, date and time and then the story is over. A grey screen with only battery status, clock, onscreen keyboard indicator and CF icon (if CF inserted). Clock is running, and stops working after 5 minutes (00:05 is the most I've seen). Power-off does not work (keeps saying 'Bye...' for hours without turning the unit off.
Any hints on how to revive ???

11.03.02

Custom Flash-ROM (and back in business)

I just managed to read and modify the CASIO 'factory restore' ROM-image. Want to try it ?
Open the file d:pcconBACKUP.BIN with winimage (http://www.winimage.com/) ...
Now you can see and modify the contents of the image: it's an uncompressed raw-image with a custom 512bytes CASIO header.

I took the factory-restore image, deleted ALL the contents, put it on my CF-card (My Documents/Backup) and did a restore from it: now my BE gives an error when booting about an invalid CF (no time to read the complete message) before restarting and getting me back to the casio menu. none of the built-in applications work, but all my CF based apps work again (that's all I need to continue on the bootloader)
